prompt: Create a vertical six-panel product-only Isabel Marant bag moodboard with six relaxed Paris-bohemian forms: an Oskan studded hobo, soft suede shoulder bag, fringed crossbody, compact bucket, slouchy tote and metallic evening pouch. Do not include dedicated shoe, jewellery or clothing product tiles.
